userStories.title: Category Hierarchy & Administration API
userStories.description: Implement administrative category endpoints supporting 3-division hierarchy, product counts, ordering, active toggles, and deletion safety checks with audit logging
acceptanceCriteria: GET /api/v1/admin/categories returns all divisions and subcategories with product counts, level, order, and parent references
GET /api/v1/admin/categories/:id returns category details with associated active products and child subcategories
POST /api/v1/admin/categories creates a new category or subcategory with slug, order, HS chapter, and audit log
PUT /api/v1/admin/categories/:id updates category attributes, level, and parentId with audit log
PATCH /api/v1/admin/categories/:id/toggle-active toggles public visibility on visitor menus and search filters
PATCH /api/v1/admin/categories/reorder updates sequence order across siblings
DELETE /api/v1/admin/categories/:id safely prevents deletion if active products exist in category, or soft-deletes with audit log
RBAC strictly restricts category modifications to admin and editor roles

userStories.title: Categories & Divisions Desk UI with Hierarchy Drawer
userStories.description: Build complete Categories & Divisions page using DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminDrawer with tree view and division tabs
acceptanceCriteria: Categories page renders with DataTable, FilterBar, and AdminStatusBadge components
Table displays Division/Category Name with level badges, Slug, HS Chapter, Display Order, Assigned Products count, and Active status
FilterBar provides division tabs (All, Personal Care, Nutraceutical, Animal Feed) and search input
Detail drawer features 3 focused tabs: 1) Division Details & HS Chapter, 2) Parent Nesting & Ordering, 3) SEO Metadata & Visibility
Delete action warns user and blocks deletion if active products are assigned to the category

userStories.title: Automated Category Test Coverage & Zero Public Regression
userStories.description: Verify category administration features with integration tests and confirm zero public site regression
acceptanceCriteria: Admin API client in client/src/admin/api.js provides fetchAdminCategories, fetchAdminCategoryById, createAdminCategory, updateAdminCategory, deleteAdminCategory, toggleAdminCategoryActive, and reorderAdminCategories
Automated integration tests in server/tests/category-admin.test.js cover category hierarchy, product count calculation, active toggles, and RBAC security
All client and server test suites pass with 100% success
Zero visual regression on public site verified via verify:no-change
